note: RFC 9162 section 2.1.5 worked example uses symbolic leaves d0..d6 with no byte values, so nothing is vendorable from the RFC text itself; the transparency-dev/merkle vectors are built on the same RFC 6962 Merkle Tree Hash and are the byte-level vectors. subtreeinclusion/subtreeconsistency directories (not RFC 6962 proofs) are deliberately not vendored.
